data.name: Lavena
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Lavena was the goddess of spring and growth. Her name is derived from the word 'lavenon', meaning 'to bathe in laurel'. This name is often associated with prosperity, renewal, and the promise of new beginnings.

in_latin.name: Lavenna
